summary: Improve video, audio and graphics workflows with hands-on production planning and QA. Explore the advanced course outline.
lede: Digital content production brings video, audio and graphics into a coordinated workflow, from briefing through quality checks and handoff. For experienced producers, editors and creative leads, the course builds practical skills in developing briefs and shot lists, managing media ingest and version control, and reviewing picture, audio and accessibility. Exercises create usable workflow and quality-assurance outputs for production and release decisions.
audienceIntro: This advanced course is designed for professionals who already contribute to multimedia production and need stronger control over asset quality, workflow coordination and delivery across video, audio and graphics.
prerequisites: Prior professional involvement in at least one area of video, audio or graphic production, plus working familiarity with relevant editing applications. No coding or programming is required.
